title: Lizardmen Reskin - Female Anthro Scalies
author: Chatmat
description:
Overview

This is a model and animation change for the Kroxigor, Saurus & Skink lord and units for the Lizardmen faction.

This mod edits the main_units & land_units tables to make the new models use the different skeletons.

This mod is not compatible with any other that edits the Kroxigor, Saurus & Skink unit stats!

This is an ongoing project that has taken the better part of 5 months to develop.

I will not be editing the legendary lords for the Lizardmen.

Features

-
3 model variants for each unit which include base, blessed, ROR & lord.

-
Each variant has a set of unique tribal warpaint designs.

-
War-paints match faction color masks, so you will see a variety of color schemes.

-
1 model for each unit has a nude variant whilst the other 2 are more lewd outfits.

-
New unit cards, portraits & portholes to match the design change.

Installation

Simply download the pack file and place it in the "Total War WARHAMMER III\data" folder and enable the pack in the mod manager of your choice.

Please only use one the files in the download section.

Media Full HD
